sources: the pinned world SQL v0.9.296 (cache/m6/4/world.sqlite, read offline; cache/m6/5/facts.md): Brighteyes 22642's Give set 48426 for the Tusker Redeemer Tusk 22430 (its quest column is NULL: she stamps and inquires nothing); the tusk's Quest string (weenie_properties_string type 33) is TuskRedeemerPickup

timer_seconds 72000 (D57): the PICKUP's gate, not Brighteyes's: quest row TuskRedeemerPickUp (id 5064) min_Delta 72000 s = 20 h, max_Solves -1; ACE refuses to pick this tusk from a corpse that is not the player's own while the quest cannot be solved again (Player_Inventory.cs:1249-1262; HandleSolveError QuestManager.cs:558-578), so one Tusker Redeemer Tusk per 20 hours; a completion is recorded at the turn-in, so the next due time is never early
level: min 20 and max null are the ground tusker-abode's entry portal 22654 MinLevel 20 and MaxLevel (none) (weenie_properties_int types 86 and 87; the profile's entry block)
experience: fixed 750,000 (the AwardXP amount_64 of emote 48426), not level-proportional

hunt-until: the carrier 22601 Tusker Redeemer is on the tusker-abode profile's targets; the item is the tusk 22430 (one per kill, a guaranteed Contain row); the step's count 1 is checked before the hunt, so a tusk already held skips it (the autopilot's errand runs this same file)

The Aphus Lassel Portal Gem 22729 that Brighteyes gives is the rung change's fallback (item 4's travel file gems, 'aphus-lassel': spell 2936 'Entrance to Tusker Island', arriving at the Refuge 0xF6820033): the turn-in's reward is also the way back to the Refuge, and item 4's travel file names this item as its source
